idea-plugin.name: Marp for JetBrains
idea-plugin.description:
Live preview of Marp Markdown presentations inside JetBrains IDEs.

Features

  • Live preview of Marp Markdown in a split editor tab
  • Hot-reload on edit
  • Auto-install of Marp CLI (requires Node.js 18+)
  • Configurable Node.js / Marp CLI paths

Requirements

  • Node.js 18 or newer installed on your system
  • IntelliJ Platform 2024.3 or newer
